FYI: It's now been two weeks since the president's national address, in which he said the conflict would be over in "two to three weeks."

We just announced failed negotiations and a Naval blockade on the Strait of Hormuz with zero timeline.

I wrote this on Thursday. Everything that just happened in these "negotiations" seems to affirm it; we're improvising in real time, we're reaching for walls in the darkness, and there is no obvious path to get out.
This, from Ezra Klein, is well-said. It’s also a literal billboard for @TangleNews

Excited to announce that we are hiring for two full-time positions at @TangleNews — one is an in-person associate editor role in the NYC/NJ area, and the other is a fully remote video editor position. Links to job listings below 👇
